motion.name: ui-speed
motion.purpose: Standard transition speed for hover and active states.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1a146b; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #312e81; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #312e81; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Standard secondary button used for cancel actions, navigation links, and settings overrides.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0d1c2e; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #777682; color: #0d1c2e; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Section Card
components.description: Used to wrap separate sections on a dashboard or page.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card-section { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-card-section:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(13, 28, 46, 0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #0d1c2e; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #474651; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: DistillLearn's visual identity is built to replicate the clean, quiet concentration of a scholar's physical workstation. It is a highly focused, professional environment where design is secondary to the study tasks at hand.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained utility: Elements are functional, clear, and uniform, avoiding decorative widgets.
High-contrast readability: Crisp type pairing and strict compliance with WCAG AA contrast rules.
Zero-distraction workspace: No neon gradients, no rounded cartoon bubbles, and no unnecessary animations.

rules.name: The Rarity of Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is used for active state indications, focus highlights, and main call-to-actions only. It must cover less than 10% of any given screen layout.

rules.name: The Text Contrast Rule
rules.body: Muted text and placeholder labels must achieve a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background (do not fade labels into light gray).

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Typography sizes are fixed, relying on structural columns to reflow content. Fluid clamp scaling is prohibited in the interface to maintain text block density.

rules.name: The Line-Length Rule
rules.body: Any block of study text or prose description must be capped at 65–75ch for optimal reading and scanning speed.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces and cards are flat at rest, with a border width of exactly 1px. Shadows appear only on transient containers (dropdowns, dialogs) or as a response to interactive hover/focus states.

dos: Do ensure all text hits a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
Do maintain a strict 1px border grid to define layout boundaries.
Do use skeleton loading states instead of blocking spinners.
Do respect the 65-75ch readability rule for study content.
donts: Don't use side-stripe borders (e.g. border-left or border-right greater than 1px) to accent active nav items or cards.
Don't use gradient text overlays or glassmorphic blur panels.
Don't use warm beige/cream colors for the background.
Don't use display fonts for buttons, forms, or metadata labels.
